errors.text_span: разположени с равни интервали от 2010 до 2030 година, с етикети на всеки две години
errors.evidence: The description claims the x-axis has equal intervals of two years. However, the tick marks are placed at 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2025, and 2030, which are not uniform intervals.
The description states that the value in 2018 is around 250 USD/KWh, but the chart shows the value is clearly below 200 USD/KWh, approximately at 180 USD/KWh.

errors.text_span: достигайки стойност около 100 USD/KWh към 2030 година
errors.evidence: The description states that the value in 2030 is around 100 USD/KWh, but the chart shows it to be significantly lower, at approximately 60-70 USD/KWh.
The description fails to mention the legend, which explicitly labels the line as 'Цена за USD/KWh' (Price for USD/KWh).
